title: A local thinking model on Home's dev set, beside Claude's stored runs
request: The owner: compare the best Qwen thinking model that fits an 8 GB Mac with every Home run so far; never run Claude beside it again, build the benchmark from Claude's past runs; keep a local model's whole reasoning for training.
spec: Home's 36 dev cases on Qwen3.5-4B (Ollama, 16k context); the benchmark from stored results and logs only.
plan: Pick the model by memory and disk
Check its reasoning reaches the exchange log
Floors for a slow local endpoint: timeout and output tokens
A benchmark builder over stored runs, chunked runs as one column
Run in resumable chunks with a disk guard

decisions.why: the Mac has 8 GB of memory and 9 GB of free disk; the 9B weights (about 6.6 GB) and the swap that grows beside them would cross the 2 GB disk floor, as swap did twice before

decisions.decision: A tier timeout floor (DCLAB_TIER_<TIER>_TIMEOUT), never a cut
decisions.why: the purposes' seconds are set for a hosted model; a 4B model thinking on a laptop wrote about 10 tokens a second

decisions.decision: A tier output-token floor (DCLAB_TIER_<TIER>_MAX_TOKENS), said in the comparison
decisions.why: Claude's 1,800-token limit left Qwen an empty reply after 1,800 tokens of reasoning; the comparison states that the local model had more room

decisions.decision: Claude's columns from stored runs only
decisions.why: the owner: no Claude run beside the local model; HOME-023/024 are the same code and the same cases

decisions.decision: Calls belong to a run by model and time window
decisions.why: the Opus and Sonnet runs were made side by side; the model name keeps them apart

change: Tier floors for a slow local endpoint (settings.options timeout_floor and max_tokens_floor; gateway._timeout; ChatClient._limit), the Home benchmark builder dclab_rnd.agent_eval.home.compare (stored results, the usage log and the kept exchanges; chunked runs joined into one column), tests in tests/test_models_reasoning_field.py and tests/test_home_compare.py, .env.example.

findings.defect: A local thinking model returned an empty reply on Home's intent and first agent call
findings.scenario: Qwen3.5-4B on Ollama, Home's eval case d-p1, the gateway's default limit of 1,800 output tokens.
findings.cause: The model writes its whole reasoning before the answer; 1,800 tokens held about 7,000 characters of reasoning and no reply.
findings.fix: DCLAB_TIER_<TIER>_MAX_TOKENS raises every request's limit on that tier to a floor (8,000 for the run).

findings.defect: A local model's calls would time out at the purpose's 60 to 90 seconds
findings.scenario: Qwen3.5-4B on an 8 GB M1: 175 to 295 seconds a call with reasoning.
findings.cause: The purposes' timeouts are set for a hosted model.
findings.fix: DCLAB_TIER_<TIER>_TIMEOUT, a floor in seconds for the tier.

findings.defect: Swap beside the loaded model shrank free disk from 5.4 to 3.8 GB in minutes
findings.scenario: Qwen loaded (4.1 GB) with the desktop apps on an 8 GB Mac.
findings.cause: macOS grows swap files on the system disk under memory pressure.
findings.fix: The run goes in chunks that start only above 2.5 GB free and stop below 2 GB; it waits for the owner to free memory at night.
findings.test: none: an operating rule of the run script

measurements.name: Benchmark from stored runs (no model called)
measurements.gate: the numbers match the earlier analysis
measurements.result: HOME-024 Sonnet 5.5 xhigh: kind 33/36, fields 72/3/5, traps 6/6; HOME-023 Opus 5.5 high: 32/36, 72/2/6, 5/6; HOME-018 Sonnet older code: 33/36, 71/4/5, 6/6

outcome: The floors and the benchmark builder are in; the Qwen run itself was stopped by the owner and waits for the night.
lessons: A local thinking model needs room to finish its reasoning: a hosted model's limits measure the wrong thing
On an 8 GB machine the disk, not the memory, is the limit: swap grows into it
risks: The output floor gives the local model more room than Claude had; the comparison must say so
